gloss: to carry out thoroughly; to see through to the end

definitions.gloss: to carry out thoroughly; to see through to the end; to accomplish completely
definitions.explanation: To persist with something from start to finish without giving up, ensuring complete execution of a plan, belief, or course of action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫徹|かんてつ}する。
⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫徹|かんてつ}した。
examples.english: I saw the policy through to the very end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直面|ちょくめん}して→直面する：15862_chokumensuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信念|しんねん}→信念：03074_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫徹|かんてつ}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Even when facing difficulties, it is important to see your beliefs through to the end.

notes:
Describes the act of carrying something out completely and thoroughly without wavering. Emphasizes determination and persistence through the entire process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{意志|いし}→意志：01712_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫徹|かんてつ}する: to carry out one's will
- ⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫徹|かんてつ}する: to see a policy through
- ⟦{信念|しんねん}→信念：03074_shinnen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫徹|かんてつ}する: to hold firm to one's beliefs
- ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貫徹|かんてつ}する: to accomplish one's objective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧: to pierce through / to stick to — focuses on the act of persisting, less formal
- ⟦{遂行|すいこう}する→遂行する：20156_suikousuru⟧: to carry out / to execute — focuses on completing a task or duty, more bureaucratic
- ⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧: to be thorough — emphasizes thoroughness rather than seeing something through from start to finish

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. Common in written language, speeches, and news reporting. In everyday conversation, ⟦{貫|つらぬ}く→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧ or ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ are more natural.
